notes.title: v1.7 update
notes.notes:
v1.7

- All UI Reworked

- Level 19, 20, 21 added

- Grammar fixes on ui

- Supporter Wall is moved to our discord server

- discord button linked to our server added on the main menu

- The Running Man is now not longer free to play, it cost 2.99$ USD for new player to play the game.
 If you got the game before this update you can still play the game.
